nodes.name: repo.test.ts
nodes.summary: 验证 OpenCode 应用与兼容层 的行为，实际用例包括「list returns empty when no accounts exist、active returns none when no accounts exist、persistAccount inserts and getRow retrieves、persistAccount normalizes trailing slashes in stored server URLs、persistAccount sets the active account and org、list returns all accounts、remove deletes an account」。

nodes.name: service.test.ts
nodes.summary: 验证 OpenCode 应用与兼容层 的行为，实际用例包括「login resolves origin-rooted verification URLs from servers with base paths、login rejects malformed device verification URLs、login maps transport failures to account transport errors、orgsByAccount groups orgs per account、remove switches to another org when the active account is removed、token refresh persists the new token、token refreshes before expiry when inside the eager refresh window」。

nodes.name: directory.test.ts
nodes.summary: 验证 Agent Client Protocol 适配层 的行为，实际用例包括「ACP directory snapshot、two concurrent callers share one load、warm calls use cached data、different directories get different snapshots、model variant lookup works、commands and modes are included、falls back when the default mode is not available」。

nodes.name: agent.test.ts
nodes.summary: 验证 OpenCode 应用与兼容层 的行为，实际用例包括「returns default native agents when no config、build agent has correct default properties、plan agent denies edits except .opencode/plans/*、plan agent denies the general subagent by default、user permission can allow the general subagent from plan mode、explore agent denies edit and write、explore agent asks for external directories and allows whitelisted external paths」。

nodes.name: plan-mode-subagent-bypass.test.ts
nodes.summary: 验证 OpenCode 应用与兼容层 的行为，实际用例包括「subagent permissions take precedence over parent agent restrictions、subagent、custom subagent can explicitly enable edits denied to its parent agent、subagent self permissions are preserved、subagent inherits parent session deny rules as hard runtime ceilings」。

nodes.name: auth.test.ts
nodes.summary: 验证 OpenCode 应用与兼容层 的行为，实际用例包括「Auth、set normalizes trailing slashes in keys、set cleans up pre-existing trailing-slash entry、remove deletes both trailing-slash and normalized keys、set and remove are no-ops on keys without trailing slashes」。

nodes.name: job.test.ts
